segments.he: יָתֵיב מָרִימָר וְקָאָמַר לְהָא שְׁמַעְתָּא מִשְּׁמֵיהּ דְּנַפְשֵׁיהּ. אֲמַר לֵיהּ רָבִינָא לְמָרִימָר: אַתּוּן הָכִי מַתְנִיתוּ לַהּ, אֲנַן כְּדִבְעָא מִינֵּיהּ רֵישׁ לָקִישׁ מֵרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן מַתְנִינַן לַהּ.
segments.en: The Gemara relates: «Mareimar sat and stated this halakha» with regard to one who attaches a condition to his vow to bring a thanks-offering «in his own name,» without attributing it to the Sage who stated it. «Ravina said to Mareimar: You teach this» halakha «in this manner,» without attribution, whereas «we teach it» in the form of a question that «Reish Lakish asked of Rabbi Yoḥanan.»

edges.proposedPredicate: challenge.corrects_attribution_of — «אתון הכי מתניתו לה, אנן ... מתנינן לה» — tells a colleague to his face that he states a dictum without its source, setting his own school's attributed version against it; reports_variant_attribution records only the variant, and objects_to attacks content with a source
